name: Buspirone
metabolism: CYP3A4-mediated oxidation forms hydroxylated metabolites and active 1-pyrimidinylpiperazine (1-PP). Metabolites leave through both urine and feces.
summary: Buspirone is an anxiolytic medication primarily used for generalized anxiety disorder. It acts mainly at serotonin 5-HT1A receptors and, unlike benzodiazepines, does not usually cause significant sedation, dependence, or withdrawal symptoms.
